name: ChipGroup
purpose: Lets users turn on any number of filters from a small, visible set, shown as toggle chips.
neverUseFor: A single on/off filter — use one Chip alone instead
Mutually exclusive choices or a view switch — use SegmentedControl or RadioGroup instead
Form answers that are submitted and validated — use CheckboxGroup instead
Large option sets or anything needing search — use MultiSelect instead
Removable active-filter chips — render dismissible Chips directly, 4px apart (group-spacing.md)

authored.name: checked
authored.description: A filter is on — its chip renders in the checked style.

authored.name: disabled
authored.description: The whole group, or an individual option, is non-interactive.
authored.aria: disabled (native HTML attribute) on each affected chip

anatomy.description: Root element — groups the legend and the chips for assistive tech.
Accessible group label. Sits 8px above the chips — see .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-spacing.md. Visually hidden with hideLabel (still read by screen readers).
Wrapping row of chips, 4px apart in both directions (.ai/maps/patterns/group-spacing.md). Each option renders a real `Chip`.
Helper text for the whole group. Sits 8px below the chips.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible group label, rendered as the fieldset's legend.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the legend visually but keeps it for screen readers — for a filter row whose purpose is already clear from context.

props.name: options
props.description: The filters. Each option: { value, label, icon?, disabled? }.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Selection change handler — receives the full updated set of selected values.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of every chip in the group — Chip's own size scale.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text shown below the group.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every chip in the group.

height.note: Inherited unchanged from Chip's own size scale (Chip's local density model, not the ADR-004 control ladder).

width.note: The chip row wraps onto more lines when it runs out of width; rows sit 4px apart, same as the chips.

a11y.role: group (native fieldset/legend + independent toggle buttons with aria-pressed)
keyboardNav: Tab - moves focus between chips and into/out of the group
